library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-json-core only defines the JsonMapper API, JsonNode, JsonFeatures and related types. JsonMapper.createDefault() and the mapper-based paths need a JsonMapper implementation on the classpath, and json-core does not ship one. The nearest implementation is micronaut-jackson-databind, which is released in lockstep with micronaut-core at 5.1.3. I did not verify that the 5.1.3 artifact resolves.

deterministic_setup.reason: Provides the JsonMapper implementation (JacksonDatabindMapper and its supplier) that json-core discovers through ServiceLoader. Without it the tests can only exercise JsonNode, so coverage stays shallow.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Use the same version for every Micronaut artifact via $libraryVersion, as the existing micronaut-core and micronaut-jackson-core tests do. Add micronaut-core, micronaut-inject and assertj-core test dependencies only if the generated tests need them. Create the mapper with JsonMapper.createDefault() or JacksonDatabindMapper. Cover reading and writing JsonNode trees, JsonMapper.readValue, writeValueAsBytes and writeValue, Argument and generic-type reads, JsonStreamConfig and JsonFeatures, and the JsonNode builders (createObjectNode, createArrayNode and the scalar nodes). No Docker image, environment variable or system property is needed.
risks: micronaut-jackson-databind:5.1.3 was not checked against Maven Central, so its existence is unconfirmed.
jackson-databind comes in transitively. The reflection and resource metadata needed for native-image may then come from the Jackson or databind metadata and not from json-core itself.
If the test uses JsonMapper.createDefault() and the supplier is not discovered in native-image, ServiceLoader metadata may be needed.
